name: Agile Gadgets for Jira
tagline: Burndown, velocity, cumulative flow, cycle time, pivots, release burndown, epic progress and WIP, rebuilt from issue history. Free for 10 users, then US$0.60 per user.
highlights: Sprint burndown and burnup, velocity, cumulative flow, cycle and lead time, issue statistics pivot, release burndown, epic progress and WIP by status.
Charts replay status and sprint changes from the changelog, with scope-change markers that name the issues and a commitment baseline at the sprint start instant.
Velocity always reconciles committed, added and removed; CFD bands never go negative; every gadget exports its series as CSV.
